acceptance_criteria.description: RegionEndpointRouter resolves CN (+86/0086) and Global calling codes to observed auth URLs when configured, supports test overrides, and rejects invalid region codes cleanly.
acceptance_criteria.test_oracle: TEST-AUTH-301: Region routing table asserts grit-cloud.cn (+86/0086) vs grit-cloud.com (+1/+44) and rejects blank/malformed region codes.

acceptance_criteria.description: UriValidator requires https/wss and rejects userinfo, blank hosts, and non-loopback cleartext schemes while allowing loopback solely in MockServerConfig.
acceptance_criteria.test_oracle: TEST-AUTH-301: Negative URI table verifies rejection of http://, ws://, user:pass@host, and blank hosts outside test loopback.

acceptance_criteria.description: Clean-room code omits global HttpsURLConnection SSL factory mutation, hardcoded secrets, tracking SDKs, and proprietary vendor binaries.
acceptance_criteria.test_oracle: TEST-AUTH-301: Static source scan asserts zero setDefaultSSLSocketFactory, zero FirebaseAnalytics, and zero com.yugong references.

acceptance_criteria.description: Pure Kotlin com.weback.robot.domain defines typed auth contracts with zero Android, coroutine, serialization, or OkHttp imports.
acceptance_criteria.test_oracle: TEST-AUTH-302: DomainPurityTest asserts zero prohibited framework or network imports across new domain auth models.

acceptance_criteria.description: OkHttpAuthGateway serializes JSON POST login envelope via kotlinx.serialization with isolated PasswordDigestStrategy and places token/region in HTTP headers (not query strings).
acceptance_criteria.test_oracle: TEST-AUTH-302: MockWebServer RecordedRequest inspection verifies POST JSON header/payload shape, token/region headers, and empty query credentials.

acceptance_criteria.description: Negative auth responses (HTTP 401/403/5xx, malformed JSON, code != 1, empty token/URLs/region, expired_time <= 0) fail closed to AuthResult.Failure without mutating active sessions.
acceptance_criteria.test_oracle: TEST-AUTH-303: Fault-injected MockWebServer negative response matrix verifies AuthResult.Failure and preserved prior valid session state.

acceptance_criteria.description: SessionStateMachine models mutually exclusive states (SignedOut, Authenticating, Authenticated, Refreshing, ReauthenticationRequired) with single-flight synchronization.
acceptance_criteria.test_oracle: TEST-AUTH-304: Concurrent coroutine signIn tests assert single gateway dispatch and deterministic FSM transitions.

acceptance_criteria.description: Explicit signOut and forced session invalidation atomically wipe persisted tokens, close active sockets cleanly, transition state, and advance sessionEpoch.
acceptance_criteria.test_oracle: TEST-AUTH-304: signOut and HTTP 401 invalidation sequences verify wiped TokenStore, closed transport, and incremented sessionEpoch.

acceptance_criteria.description: Late callbacks carrying a superseded sessionEpoch are discarded without leaking tokens or restoring signed-out sessions.
acceptance_criteria.test_oracle: TEST-AUTH-304: Suspended stale login/refresh callback finishing after signOut is ignored due to sessionEpoch mismatch.

acceptance_criteria.description: TokenExpiryPolicy evaluates 80% proactive renewal and 100% expiration via Long MonotonicClock math without float NaN or Int overflow.
acceptance_criteria.test_oracle: TEST-AUTH-305: Exact boundary table at 80% (2880000ms vs 2880001ms), 100% (3600000ms), and Int.MAX_VALUE validates overflow-safe expiry.

acceptance_criteria.description: When an explicit refresh grant handler is configured, concurrent refresh triggers collapse into one single-flight refresh updating TokenStore atomically.
acceptance_criteria.test_oracle: TEST-AUTH-305: Virtual-time concurrent refresh tests assert 1 RefreshGrantHandler execution updating persisted TokenStore.

acceptance_criteria.description: Without a passwordless refresh grant or upon refresh failure, SessionCoordinator clears expired tokens and moves to ReauthenticationRequired with zero password caching.
acceptance_criteria.test_oracle: TEST-AUTH-305: Passwordless default & failed refresh paths verify transition to ReauthenticationRequired and zero stored password digests.

acceptance_criteria.description: KeystoreAeadTokenStore uses Android Keystore 256-bit AES-GCM with unique 12B IVs and AAD in noBackupFilesDir, strictly excluding EncryptedSharedPreferences and password storage.
acceptance_criteria.test_oracle: TEST-AUTH-306: AEAD storage test asserts ciphertext differs from plaintext token bytes, IV uniqueness across saves, and zero EncryptedSharedPreferences references.

acceptance_criteria.description: AEADBadTagException, KeyPermanentlyInvalidatedException, truncated bytes, or corrupt payloads fail closed by wiping stored ciphertext and returning CorruptedOrInvalidated.
acceptance_criteria.test_oracle: TEST-AUTH-307: Bit-flip tamper, version mismatch, truncation, and Keystore invalidation tests assert file deletion and TokenLoadResult.CorruptedOrInvalidated.

acceptance_criteria.description: SecretRedactor scrubs token/Authorization headers, password/jwt/refresh fields, and eyJ JWT substrings across HTTP/WS logs and diagnostics.
acceptance_criteria.test_oracle: TEST-AUTH-308: Log sink assertions confirm zero raw password, header token, or JWT substring leakage and verify explicit [REDACTED] markers.

acceptance_criteria.description: OkHttpDeviceInventoryGateway posts opt=user_thing_list_get with token/region headers using kotlinx.serialization.json (zero Gson).
acceptance_criteria.test_oracle: TEST-CONN-301: MockWebServer asserts exact POST JSON opt=user_thing_list_get, token/region headers, and parsed ThingBean inventory list.

acceptance_criteria.description: Missing thing_name, non-1 code, HTTP errors, or malformed JSON fail safely while valid empty thing_list returns InventoryState.Empty cleanly.
acceptance_criteria.test_oracle: TEST-CONN-301: Negative inventory payloads assert typed ConnectivityError while valid empty list asserts InventoryState.Empty.

acceptance_criteria.description: Initial thing_status telemetry hydrates into bounded RobotState fields (battery 0..100 clamped safely, conservative mode mapping, isAdmin preserved).
acceptance_criteria.test_oracle: TEST-CONN-302: Boundary test asserts noisy out-of-range battery and unrecognized working_status hydrate cleanly without unhandled exceptions.

acceptance_criteria.description: DeviceCapabilityClassifier normalizes sub_type prefixes matching utils/c.java (Laser P0/q1, Gyro l1, XMPP e1/T0/H0, Camera n1, Peripherals m1/N0/Y0/v0/g1, Unknown).
acceptance_criteria.test_oracle: TEST-CONN-303: Exhaustive prefix table verifies classification across Laser, Gyro, XMPP, Camera, Peripherals, and unknown strings.

acceptance_criteria.description: Capability gating restricts MVP shadow control strictly to compatible Laser SLAM devices and marks peripherals, cameras, XMPP, and unknowns unsupported without crashing.
acceptance_criteria.test_oracle: TEST-CONN-303: ControlCompatibility mapping confirms only LaserSlam returns MvpSupportedShadowWs while excluded classes return Unsupported.

acceptance_criteria.description: RealtimeSessionTransport exposes ConnectionState StateFlow with synchronized state ownership and zero locks held across socket delays.
acceptance_criteria.test_oracle: TEST-CONN-304: Concurrent connect/disconnect/send MockWebServer tests verify ordered non-blocking ConnectionState emissions.

acceptance_criteria.description: OkHttpWebSocketTransport sends token/region upgrade headers, parses thing_status_update frames, applies 20s stall + 4s virtual-time reconnect, and sends close 1000.
acceptance_criteria.test_oracle: TEST-CONN-304: MockWebServer WebSocket contract tests assert upgrade headers, telemetry frames, stall/reconnect timing, and close frame 1000.

acceptance_criteria.description: HTTP 401/403 WS upgrade rejection stops reconnect loops immediately and triggers invalidation; idempotent close() blocks post-close mutations.
acceptance_criteria.test_oracle: TEST-CONN-305: MockWebServer 401/403 handshake test verifies 0 reconnect retries and auth callback; close race test proves zero post-close state mutation.

acceptance_criteria.description: OfflineFixtureAuthGateway, OfflineFixtureInventoryGateway, and OfflineFixtureRealtimeTransport enable complete offline flows preserving OFFLINE simulator identity.
acceptance_criteria.test_oracle: TEST-CONN-306: AppContainer and offline fixture integration test runs signIn -> inventory -> capability -> WS events offline cleanly.

acceptance_criteria.description: OkHttp gateways and WebSocket transport execute deterministically against local MockWebServer in testDebugUnitTest with zero external network contact.
acceptance_criteria.test_oracle: TEST-CONN-306: Loopback MockWebServer contract suite runs offline in unit tests with zero external host connections.

acceptance_criteria.description: Active policies/checks.json and offline AndroidManifest.xml (zero INTERNET permission until isolated FCT-004 policy transition) remain preserved.
acceptance_criteria.test_oracle: TEST-CONN-307: spec-hygiene, android-lint, android-build, and apk-validation confirm zero unapproved manifest permissions or policy edits.

acceptance_criteria.description: ConnectivityError maps auth, expiry, challenge, timeout, network, handshake, and unsupported device failures to safe non-leaky UI errors.
acceptance_criteria.test_oracle: TEST-CONN-307: Error mapping tests verify every ConnectivityError variant formats safe guidance without raw tokens or stack traces.

acceptance_criteria.description: WebSocket disconnects preserve committed RobotState telemetry safely and block live remote commands while disconnected.
acceptance_criteria.test_oracle: TEST-CONN-307: Disconnect recovery test asserts committed RobotState survives socket loss and remote send returns Rejected until reconnected.

acceptance_criteria.description: All existing FCT-001/FCT-002 unit and Robolectric Compose UI tests plus 7-check policy execution remain non-regressed.
acceptance_criteria.test_oracle: TEST-CONN-307: Full testDebugUnitTest + 7-check candidate pipeline confirms all FCT-001/FCT-002 regressions and spec-hygiene pass.
